name: Philippines

customerDiscounts.label: Senior citizen
customerDiscounts.law: Republic Act 9994 (Expanded Senior Citizens Act), as amended

invoice.title: Sales Invoice
requiredFields: TIN with branch code, marked VAT REG or NON-VAT REG
Description, quantity and unit price of each item
VATable sales, VAT-exempt sales, zero-rated sales and the amount of VAT
For a senior citizen or person with a disability discount: the customer's name, ID number and signature
The BIR permit or accreditation details of the system that prints the invoices
The words THIS SERVES AS YOUR SALES INVOICE
invoice.eInvoice: The BIR is phasing in electronic invoicing (EIS) for large taxpayers and online sellers. Check whether your business is in scope.

notes: A shop that is not VAT-registered (yearly sales not above ₱3,000,000) charges no VAT and pays percentage tax itself (3% of its gross sales since 1 July 2023). Mark the shop as not VAT-registered and the receipt must say NON-VAT.

Senior citizens and persons with a disability get 20% off and no VAT on the goods and services the law covers (for example basic necessities and medicines). The program cannot know which items qualify: the cashier marks them.
Retail prices in the Philippines include VAT.
